title: Systematics-template cross-correlations
author: Cail Daley
description: TR1 galaxy clustering, shear and CMB lensing crossed with the VMPZ systematics templates in Cycle 1 and Cycle 2; the extinction template carries LSS through the CIB, and what that means for dust maps in galaxy-clustering weights.
footer: Cail Daley · GC-8 · systematics cross-correlations · October 2026

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: An update for galaxy clustering on validation with systematics-template cross-correlations.

sections.title: Template nulls
sections.outline: Six VMPZ templates crossed with TR1 density, shear and CMB lensing, and the contamination they imply for the data vector; a toggle switches Cycle 1 and Cycle 2.

sections.title: Dust maps carry LSS
sections.outline: The extinction template correlates positively with every tracer; the CIB route reproduces it; SFD correlates with the lens bins too, and CSFD's galaxy null is partly by construction.

sections.title: Closing
sections.outline: What this means for galaxy-clustering weights, and where Cycle 2 stands.
